Subject: Next steps & Security Questionnaire (SIG) — Redwood Inference

Hi Elena —

Great to meet you and Tom on today’s call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) Scope: FinovatePay is evaluating Redwood for payment-authorization enrichment (real-time inference) across US-based customers.
2) Primary security asks you flagged: SOC 2 status, data residency, HIPAA applicability, encryption/KMS, and vendor questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ or your custom form).
3) Proposed next steps:
   - I’ll initiate our SIG/CAIQ package and share instructions for completion (see attachment).
   - We’ll confirm SOC 2 scope and provide either the report or an NDA-protected SOC 2 bridge letter.
   - Marissa (cc’d) — our security engineer — will be your point on technical clarifications and evidence.

Attached: redwood_sig_request.pdf (short cover note on what we need from you), redwood_SIG_instructions.pdf (how to complete SIG/CAIQ).

Do you have a preferred SIG template (vendor portal link) or should we start with our CAIQ export? Also, what’s your target date for completing the vendor questionnaire (this week / next week / end of month)?

Thanks — I’ll wait for your preference and timeline and then coordinate with Marissa to triage the questionnaire items.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. A few clarifying questions before we start the questionnaire: 

1) SOC 2 status: Do you have a completed SOC 2 Type II report? If not, do you provide bridge letters or SOC 2 readiness documentation?
2) GDPR/HIPAA: Our workload processes payment data (card + PII). Is Redwood willing to sign a HIPAA BAA if needed, and do you have any customers currently under HIPAA?
3) Data residency: Can you confirm data centers/regions where inference is run for hosted customers? We are trying to ensure US-only residency for this project.
4) SIG timing: We can complete the SIG if you send a pre-filled export, but what’s the timeline on your side for returning evidence? We’d like to review within 5 business days once submitted.

Also looping in our security lead Tom — he may share a custom questionnaire instead of the SIG.

Thanks —
Elena
Director, Product & Partnerships
FinovatePay
elena@finovatepay.com

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Answers inline and next steps below: 

1) SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report covering our hosted API and control plane through Jan 31, 2026. We can provide the full report under NDA; alternatively we can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter and our control matrix if you prefer quicker access.

2) HIPAA: Redwood currently serves customers with regulated data; we have a HIPAA-compliant deployment pattern and are willing to sign a BAA for covered workloads. For this evaluation, we’d discuss signing a BAA as part of contracting if FinovatePay requires it.

3) Data residency: For hosted accounts we have US regions (us-west-2 and us-east-1) and EU regions for EU customers. For your use case we can restrict inference to US regions and document that in the mutual action plan.

4) SIG timing: We’ll attach a pre-filled CAIQ/SIG export to speed things up (attached). Marissa (security engineer, cc’d) will be the technical contact for any evidence requests and can complete or clarify specific questions. Typical turnaround for evidence from us is 3–5 business days once we have the exact questionnaire items; complex evidence items may take longer.

Next steps: 
- I’ve attached a pre-filled CAIQ/SSVC export (SIG_template.xlsx) and redwood_SIG_instructions.pdf with guidance on the fields we try to pre-populate.
- Marissa — can you confirm availability to support FinovatePay’s questionnaire next week? I’ll open a shared Drive folder and upload the SOC 2 report under NDA when we get confirmation.
- Elena/Tom — if you prefer, send your custom questionnaire link and we’ll map answers directly.

Links / attachments: https://drive.redwoodlabs.internal/finovatepay/SIG_template.xlsx (pre-fill), redwood_SIG_instructions.pdf.

Thanks —
Nikhil Sharma

Thanks Nikhil — that all sounds good. Tom and I reviewed and we’re happy to proceed with your pre-filled CAIQ and the shared folder approach. Two quick asks before we kick off: 

1) Please upload the SOC 2 Type II report to the shared folder behind an NDA link (we can sign if needed).
2) Can Marissa provide initial answers on encryption at rest (KMS provider) and key separation / customer-managed keys (if supported)? These are high-priority items for our security review.

We aim to finish the questionnaire review by next Friday (2026-03-20).

Looping security@finovatepay.com for any logistics.

Cheers,
Elena
